reviews.text: Staff are fab and very knowledgeable such a lovely well stocked shop

Fantastic staff, very friendly and helpful.
The girls just love Sadie as she does them, so much so that she now tags along on our Friday visits.
She loves getting groomed here too, and comes away looking very pretty.
She's also been known to give the staff a hand(or should I say paw) behind the counter.
🤣😂
What can I add....
They're absolutely brilliant and I agree with Sadie
Great shop got everything I need that bigger pet shops nearby didn't have

One star as there is no option to give none! Extremely disappointing experience with their grooming service. We made it very clear that our dog was not to be shaved, as she has a coat type that should not be shaved. Any qualified professional groomer should be able to recognise this.

Our dog had a beautiful coat, and she now looks like a completely different dog, to the point that we genuinely did not recognise her when we arrived to collect her. Her coat has been ruined.

What is most upsetting is that our direct and clear instructions were completely ignored. Instead of respecting what we explicitly asked for, they chose to do what they wanted anyway. We trusted them with our dog and are incredibly upset and disappointed. Her coat most likely will never grow back!
Worse groomers ever

I have been going to this pet shop & groomer for years with my dogs but never again the cuts both my dogs were given on last 2 occasions are diabolical.  Chopped & butchered their coats to bits.( not a clue how to groom FACT !) Steer clear if you don't want to be very disappointed.

The girl in the shop was amazing she went out of her way to help me out.
Loved her recommendation for my dogs diet.  Thanks so much
Second time in 3 years that all the groomers have walked out and left me with no appointment for my dog. Please don't call me or my husband when you have another groomer because I won't be back.
Lovely family run local pet store. Friendly staff & great value

Great products and wonderful staff !
My dogs are always excited when we call in here and they never let me pass this shop without bringing them in for a visit ☺️
Has no fishes

Fantastic experience in this store they really do go above and beyond for every customer from what I saw but myself today I was in desperate need of a rabbit hutch and they got it sorted form and couldn’t be any more helpful fantastic customer experience thanks a million keep up the good work

First time bringing my dog to Mutz Nutz in walkinstown.

My dog has never looked so fresh and clean ever! I am glad I changed to this groomer! Would highly recommend!!! Very friendly staff and a very welcoming environment!

Thanks again!

I will be back !
Great variety of products and friendly staff :)
Wonderful people so kind my dog is 15 a grumpy old lady they were so good with her can't recommend them highly enough
They are great for grooming  my lady
I love this local pet shop. Helpful staff. Great selection.
Friendly and helpful staff.

While it’s a nice shop, they clearly have management and staff issues. So many products didn’t have a price displayed, they weren’t busy so it seems to be a choice. Having looked at the reviews seems there are other issues letting the place down.
Staff were lovely and very helpful with my dog’s training being very patient and helping me with things. Had woolf food which is so great too! Will be back soon

Total letdown. Ordered 2 bags of expensive dog food for delivery (2 day lead in time)
No delivery as agreed.
Have no dog food for tomorrow morning 😕 …

Took a deposit for Christmas grooming and told me at the time they would ring or text the day before to confirm. Never phoned or messaged either before or even at the time of the appointment. I live 2 mins away could have brought the dogs. Took no responsibility when phoned. If running a business don't make statements of service that aren't true. Mistakes happen it's how they are resolved thats important - blame the customer, no apology and  no attempt to resolve the problem
Lovely staff and owner adorable animals including the cute parrot love coming here
Amazing staff with real care for animals and customers
Poor selection on cat food, and no customer service.

Yesterday I went to Mutz Nutz, Walkinstown, to get supplies for my new puppy. I explained to the staff that I was getting loads and they were beyond helpful and super kind! I was going back and forth because some of the bits were bigger, i.e, crate and bed. The staff helped me even bring the crate to the counter and then car. They helped me pick between leads and collars. Thank you so much! I can't wait to bring the puppy in to meet the lovely staff here and to come back and get him groomed too!
Simply enjoyable
Staff were extremely nice and helpful definitely recommend

Was booked in for a groom for a cat dropped the cat off to be rang 20 mins later sayin the cat was not booked in when it clearly was they took the cat and knew bout it after waitin for an appointment really bad service avoid go to a real groomer

Was looking to buy dog food for our puppy, we weren't sure what to get. Staff member was very helpful and told us to buy a small bag first to see how the pup was eating it. Needless to say the pup loved the food, so thank you to the staff.

Avoid this dog groomers, I feel like going the garda for cruelty to animals, he has no hair ,pink skin, blood marks , he is traumatised and shaking. 4 hours waiting and gave my dog to another woman, she came back in the shop saying this is not my dog, blood marks were his skin was cut , he's just sitting on the chair shaking. Please do not take your pet here. This is a butchers shop..one star is too much..I feel like charging them wit cruelty to animals..please Avoid..
Very helpful staff
Very nice shop & staff
Great selection, they care about animals
Nice people and the groomers do a great job.
Very good staff were very friendly, been there a few times

Rescue dog went in for first cut and was treated like a king. From the second he went through the door Belle had him at ease. Friendly dog anyway but seemed immediately at home. Was so relaxed in the car on the way home you would swear he'd spent a day at the spa.
Cute little pet shop and normally have what I need, however, I’ve found that the staff can sometimes be very “anti-vet”
Friendly staff. My dog fell asleep after his groom. He never did that anywhere else
Grooming service here is fantastic, the dog loves it. All staff are friendly and helpful. Good selection of essentials, too.
Great staff. Friendly, helpful.
For all your pets needs
lovely staff and they are very knowledgeable and friendly.
Staff so friendly

Rebecca and Kelly are fantastic employees - very helpful, very well informed and willing to help. I was starting from scratch with a new rescue dog and felt that I could rely on their expertise 100%. They even welcomed my dog and I back just to say hi and socialise as my little dog was so happy being in their store. I have bought the frozen raw dog food to try having had a good chat with Rebecca about it and that was great reassurance as it can be overwhelming with all the information available online. I can’t wait to bring my little one back to Mutz Nutz Walkinstown!
Incredibly kind and helpful staff who gave me great advice today. Delighted to learn they do grooming as well. Will definitely be back in the new year.
Excellent groom and advice on dog food
Very helpfull staff
Good store plenty of choice . Staff friendly and helpful .
For all your pets, food friendly staff
Best pet shop ever
Really good, staff are great.

Great local pet supply shop in Dublin 12, if not a little pricy, but friendly  knowledgeable staff.
It's hard for the kids not to be distracted from the pet Bunnies and Guniepigs for sale.
